label: copy-phase input d (strongest when the next output is d/w, mid-copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>) and almost only when the fed-back input token is d (98.5% of activation mass; a little on input w). Copy-phase d input alone covers 97% of activations and 98% of mass but has only 7% precision. Firing is far more likely when the token being output after the d is d or w (and to a lesser degree c or 0), at recall positions 3-5, and not on the last output step. The top activations are d inputs at recall index 3-4 in long sequences (L = 8-9) followed by d or w. The gated predicate gets dev precision 0.60, recall 0.53, F1 0.56. Which d inputs fire beyond these conditions is not captured. It never fires on the first occurrence of a token, on original-phase d, or on other letters apart from w.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: d, w; t=13: d, w; t=11: d, w) and the token being output (most: d, w, c, 0, a, f; least: p, g, 1, 3); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=14.
